land_case.evidence: Red label p1 'CASE No. 367 SOUTHERN DISTRICT'; page stamps '367 SD'; US District Court docket No. 367 (p31/p43). Board/Land Commission docket = No. 407 (= Hoffman commission_no 407). Register 'SD 367' = OK.

outcome.evidence: Register 'Patented' (to heirs of Henry S. Burton). The file shows the claim was ultimately CONFIRMED: Land Commission REJECTED (opinion transcript p27, transcript certified 10 Jan 1856); on appeal the US District Court decree of 15 June 1870 rejected the PIO PICO claim (p43-44) since Pico had conveyed all interest; the Burton heirs (widow Maria A. + children Nellie & Henry H. Burton, actual owners) were substituted and the District Court decree of 21 Sept 1870 CONFIRMED the claim to them (recited in the citation p88); the US appeal to the Supreme Court was DISMISSED on the Attorney General's motion 31 Oct 1872 (SCOTUS mandate, Dec Term 1871 No. 350, p95-98), leaving the confirmation as the final decree; District Court order 13 Dec 1872 (p93) granted the claimants leave to 'proceed under the decree of this Court as under final decree.' Confirmation verified; the GLO patent (register: 541, Oct 26 1876) is NOT physically in the pages read (Phase C checks GLO).

corrections.outcome: File resolves the Hoffman flag: register 'Patented'/confirmed is CORRECT and Hoffman-1862 'rejected' is superseded. Confirmed to the Burton heirs by US District Court decree 21 Sept 1870, made final after the Supreme Court dismissed the United States' appeal 31 Oct 1872. Patent copy not in file.

notes: PRIORITY OUTCOME FLAG resolved decisively. FILENAME DISCREPANCY: the guessed cubanc_lcf_sd367.pdf returned an HTML error page (not a 404 PDF); real file is cubanc00004371_pm_a.pdf (extracted from record HTML). This filename does NOT encode the sd367 docket, but the red label + '367 SD' page stamps confirm Case 367 Southern District. Grant history is two-stage: Victoria provisional concession 20/21 April 1831 -> Pio Pico definitive title 23 Dec 1845 (Pico granting to himself as acting governor, approved by Departmental Assembly 2 June 1846); the register/Hoffman convention records the 1831 Victoria origin. ~52 images read (past the 30-page cap) because tracing the full Land Commission -> District Court -> Supreme Court chain was required to settle the flagged outcome. PDF is 109 images; no single 'pgs' total-count leaf captured.
